title: ever AELINA|Long Sleeves Waist Applique A-Line Midi Chiffon Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Make an elegant entrance with our Long Sleeves Waist Applique A-Line Midi Chiffon Wedding Guest Dress. This sophisticated dress features an A-line silhouette with a delicate waist applique, adding a touch of charm. The long sleeves provide a graceful look, while the lightweight chiffon fabric ensures comfort throughout the event. Perfect for weddings or formal gatherings, this dress combines style and sophistication effortlessly.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Long sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
